one_liner: Build and publish external apps, manage commerce orders, inventory, and domain searches.
auth_notes: Authenticate requests by using an API key or OAuth access token.
access_notes: Self-service OAuth credential management and free developer account signup are available.
api_notes: Commerce APIs for inventory, orders, products, transactions, and webhooks.
blocker_notes: Public APIs, self-serve credentials, and an official MCP server are available.

auth.quote:

access.quote: Starting Monday, July 27, 2026, Squarespace is transitioning to a self-service model for OAuth credential management, empowering developers to build and maintain integrations with greater speed and autonomy.

api.quote: Read and write orders, products, inventory, and transactions. REST endpoints, webhooks for order events, and signed payloads for safe server-to-server delivery.

mcp.quote:
The Squarespace MCP server connects AI assistants and agents to Squarespace. Built on the
Model Context Protocol

verdict.quote:
Build on Squarespace
Everything you need to build and publish external apps — reliable APIs, clear documentation, and a marketplace to reach Squarespace's global customer base.

reasons.auth: API key and OAuth 2.0 are documented for Commerce APIs; OAuth is the primary method for third‑party integrations.
reasons.access: API keys can be generated by any merchant site without a paid plan, so credentials are self‑serve free.
reasons.mcp: An official MCP server is published at https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp and documented in the developer preview.
reasons.verdict: Public REST API documentation and free self‑serve credentials allow a developer to build a toolkit today.
